reviews.review_text:

2 contributions

Toilet water on my face
Jan 2024 • Couples
I would avoid this place even if you’re desperate for Indian food. We ordered the butter chicken, chicken …, rotti and vegetable pakora. The vegetable pakora was the only thing we could somewhat finish but everything else was just bland, greasy and heavy. Really just off putting food, personally I vomited 4 times after I arrived back to my hotel.

The one saving grace food wise was the naan, which was huge - perfect for sharing, and very nicely done. Yet the rice we ordered alongside our curries didn’t arrive for some time, and by the time we had been updated on it, the rest of the food had already taken away our appetites. 

The staff were not rude by any means, but seemed disinterested, standoffish and lingered very close by even when no dishes had arrived, which felt awkward

Overall, would not recommend, unless seeking bread and dip.
